newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein firm in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein firm in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices remained firm in late trading on Wednesday, with buying interest improving following gains in Malaysia, traders said.
They said palm olein was quoted at 1,445-50 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, compared with 1,440-50 rupiah at the opening. Crude palm oil was last done at 1,252.50 rupiah/kg in Medan.
"The market was quite active," one trader said. "The buying was triggered by increases in Malaysia." Malaysian prices rose strongly on what traders said was active short-covering.
The traders said they expected domestic palm olein prices to remain firm through the week.
"Prices have rebounded after stagnating for weeks, and I think they will be holding in the near term," one trader said. "There's talk that supply is tight due to good exports."
Another trader said state commodities regulator BULOG could intervene to cap palm olein prices if they approached the 1,500-rupiah level because of the general election next month.
"With the elections just a month away, I don't think BULOG will sit still if prices went up too much," he said. "BULOG has always said that prices should be below 1,500 rupiah."
